issues.description: README line 491 incorrectly states 'default and /model opus → claude-opus-4-6-thinking'. The provider has MODEL="claude-sonnet-4-6" (default) and MODEL_OPUS="claude-opus-4-6-thinking". Default maps to sonnet, not opus. Should read: 'Default → claude-sonnet-4-6; /model opus → claude-opus-4-6-thinking; /model sonnet, /model haiku, subagents → claude-sonnet-4-6'

summary: Provider implementation is correct and complete; only README documentation has a mapping error for default/opus tiers.
